name: h200_multibox
_comment: NVIDIA HGX/DGX Hopper Refresh H200 multi-box deployment template (8-GPU NVLink4 islands stitched by ConnectX-7 NDR InfiniBand at ~2.5 us/50 GB/s). num_devices and ib.ports are auto-overridden by `system_with_eta(..., num_devices=N)`. Intra-box: NVLink4 900 GB/s bidir per GPU through 4 NVSwitch chips. Inter-box: ConnectX-7 NDR (50 GB/s/GPU). Same chip as h200.8gpu single-box spec. Checked against the vendor's product page in November 2026: Hopper publishes 1,979 TFLOPS at 16-bit and 3,958 at 8-bit, both with sparsity (989 and 1,979 dense), and has no 4-bit tensor path (NVFP4 arrived with Blackwell), so a 4-bit model computes at the 8-bit peak: `peak_flops_TF_by_precision` says so.
